An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''individual''' once [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] [[Kajin Savaros]] using the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] to steal a [[daro root]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] from a vendor in the [[Ploughtekal Market]]. The individual went to inquire with the vendor, but before they could find Savaros, Kajin used the Force the make the bin of fruit explode to cause a scene so he could escape.<ref name="CN3" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The individual first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''. Though not explicitly said, the book heavily implies the Force-sensitive is an Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].<ref name="CN3" />
